name: svg-french-press-nemotron-3.5-super-vl-s3-r3
prompt: Draw an exploded assembly diagram of a French press, as an SVG. Use the standard three-piece plunger filter rather than a two-piece travel press.

source.text:
<svg width="560" height="950" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <defs>
    <marker id="arrowhead" markerWidth="10" markerHeight="7" refX="0" refY="3.5" orient="auto">
      <polygon points="0 0, 10 3.5, 0 7" fill="#666"/>
    </marker>
  </defs>

  <!-- Background -->
  <rect width="100%" height="100%" fill="#ffffff"/>

  <!-- Title -->
  <text x="280" y="30" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="17" font-weight="bold" fill="#333">French Press — Exploded Assembly</text>

  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <!-- Vertical center line (assembly axis) -->
  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <line x1="300" y1="140" x2="300" y2="650" stroke="#bbb" stroke-width="1.5" stroke-dasharray="7,5"/>

  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <!-- Carafe (glass beaker) — bottom -->
  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <g id="carafe">
    <!-- Glass body -->
    <rect x="190" y="660" width="220" height="190" rx="14" ry="14" fill="#e8f4fd" stroke="#5a9bd4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Bottom rim -->
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="660" rx="110" ry="11" fill="none" stroke="#5a9bd4" stroke-width="2"/>
    <!-- Handle -->
    <path d="M 410 660 Q 455 660 455 770 Q 455 860 410 860" fill="none" stroke="#5a9bd4" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <!-- Fill line -->
    <line x1="196" y1="720" x2="404" y2="720" stroke="#5a9bd4" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <!-- Plunger lid (top) -->
  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <g id="lid">
    <rect x="210" y="70" width="180" height="30" rx="5" ry="5" fill="#d9d9d9" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
    <ellipse cx="300" cy="85" rx="6" ry="6" fill="#4d4d4d"/>
    <text x="300" y="60" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#333">Lid</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <!-- Plunger rod -->
  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <g id="rod">
    <rect x="294" y="100" width="12" height="540" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#bfbfbf" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="314" y="120" text-anchor="start" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="12" fill="#333">Plunger rod</text>
  </g>

  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <!-- Three-piece filter assembly (exploded to the left of the rod) -->
  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <g id="filter">
    <text x="300" y="160" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" font-weight="bold" fill="#333">Three-piece filter</text>

    <!-- Top plate -->
    <g id="topplate">
      <rect x="150" y="260" width="110" height="10" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#b0b0b0" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
      <rect x="204" y="252" width="32" height="26" rx="3" ry="3" fill="#b0b0b0" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="140" y="266" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#333">Top plate</text>
      <line x1="260" y1="265" x2="294" y2="265" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Mesh filter -->
    <g id="mesh">
      <rect x="150" y="370" width="110" height="6" rx="1" ry="1" fill="#c8c8c8" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
      <line x1="154" y1="373" x2="256" y2="373" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="0.7" stroke-dasharray="2,2"/>
      <text x="140" y="376" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#333">Mesh filter</text>
      <line x1="260" y1="373" x2="294" y2="373" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
    </g>

    <!-- Spring / bottom plate -->
    <g id="springplate">
      <rect x="150" y="480" width="110" height="10" rx="2" ry="2" fill="#b0b0b0" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
      <ellipse cx="205" cy="485" rx="18" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#4d4d4d" stroke-width="2"/>
      <text x="140" y="486" text-anchor="end" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="11" fill="#333">Spring plate</text>
      <line x1="260" y1="485" x2="294" y2="485" stroke="#999" stroke-width="1" stroke-dasharray="4,3" marker-end="url(#arrowhead)"/>
    </g>
  </g>

  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <!-- Carafe label -->
  <!-- ========================================= -->
  <text x="300" y="870" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Arial, sans-serif" font-size="13" fill="#333">Carafe</text>

</svg>
